note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There were 29 nominations for the 23 seats (Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1); the five divisions polled were Ballyharrigan, Bellarena, Dungiven, Feeny and Owenreagh, where 'All the five outgoing members ... were returned ... in straight fights' (Londonderry Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 1 June 1961 return (Benone: D. Deighan, Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 10); the Derry Journal, 9 June 1964, p. 5 names Mr. D. Deighan as re-elected vice-chairman at the first meeting of the new council. In 1967 he was the outgoing chairman, 'Mr. Dan Deighan of Benone' (Londonderry Sentinel, 5 July 1967, p. 15). Returned unopposed.
